text: ヘラクロスは　もっと　つよそうで　かっこよくて　ツノが　すてきな　ポケモンなの！

structure.jp: もっと　つよそうで
ツノが　すてきな　ポケモンなの！
structure.en: a Pokémon with a wonderful horn!

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう swapped for the final い of a describing word means 'looks that way'. つよそう = 'strong-looking'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つよそうで　かっこよくて
patterns.explanation: で and くて join describing words into a chain, like 'and'. つよそうで　かっこよくて = 'strong-looking and cool and...'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの at the end gives an explaining, insisting tone; this is the soft womanly form of なのだ. ポケモンなの = 'it's a Pokémon that..., you see!'
